sources.title_original: Micron plans to use wafer bonding and High-NA EUV for next-gen DRAM
sources.summary: Micron rejects 4F2, intends to use wafer bonding and High-NA EUV before going 3D NAND over the next few years.
sources.summary_zh: 美光拒绝 4F2，打算在未来几年转向 3D NAND 之前使用晶圆键合和高数值孔径 EUV。

stories.title: Windows 11 的“完整 ISO”被压缩到 CD-ROM 中 / Windows 11’s ‘whole ISO’ squeezed into a CD-ROM

sources.title: Windows 11 的“完整 ISO”被压缩到 CD-ROM 中 / Windows 11’s ‘whole ISO’ squeezed into a CD-ROM
sources.title_zh: Windows 11 的“完整 ISO”被压缩到 CD-ROM 中
sources.title_en: Windows 11’s ‘whole ISO’ squeezed into a CD-ROM
sources.title_original: Windows 11’s ‘whole ISO’ squeezed into a CD-ROM
sources.summary: Professional Windows crusher NTDEV has showcased their next-generation tool for compressing Windows 11 with a video of an install that fits on a single CD-ROM.
sources.summary_zh: 专业 Windows 粉碎者 NTDEV 展示了他们用于压缩 Windows 11 的下一代工具，并附有安装视频，该工具可安装在一张 CD-ROM 上。
